answer: Copy the fixture desk: the `desk install` bullet is shared generator boilerplate reused by many CLI tasks (runs/planning/rewrite-plan/gen.py:40-44), and install only writes missing files (deskops/workspace.py:259-263), so it cannot clobber the fixture.

tests/conftest.py does not exist (no conftest.py anywhere). pytest_addoption is the only content needed; tests can read it via pytestconfig.getoption('--update-golden'). An extra fixture is not required.

No CLI creates a run dir. `closeout commit --run-dir` accepts only runs/subagents/<dir> holding board.txt, task.txt, git-status.txt, result-summary.md (deskops/cli/commands/closeout.py:24,124); tests hand-build it (tests/test_closeout.py:37-43).

Run route order: Task-Id, Run-Dir, optional Run-Id, optional Session-Sha256 (closeout.py:170-175); --no-run: Task-Id, Closeout-Mode: manual, Closeout-Reason (closeout.py:82). The `route` label strings are not in code (implementer choice).

kg.json has no timestamps or abs paths; nodes sorted by id and JSON sort_keys=True (snapshot.py:82,113), so only commit shas are volatile. nx.json order comes from external kgdb.graph.save_graph (cli/main.py:250-252), not vendored here.

Step 2 never runs `deskops graph reflect`, the only producer of .sldb/runtime/self_reflection_findings.json (self_reflection.py:15; cli/main.py:311-334); `graph build` writes only kg.json + nx.json (cli/main.py:229-252). Fix: add `graph reflect` to step 2.

No hidden or aliased subparsers: build_parser() builds the tree with plain add_parser, no SUPPRESS and no aliases, max depth 2 (parser.py:25-56). Enumerate by walking the parser tree or parsing `deskops --help`.
Existing helpers already set identity: `git config user.email/user.name` before the seed commit (tests/test_closeout.py:29-33; tests/test_lifecycle_end_to_end.py:37-43). Copy that pattern.

build_graph_snapshot needs no git commit and no .sldb store: it globs Markdown (extract_docs.py:58-113) and tests run it on a bare tmp_path with id/title frontmatter only (tests/test_graph_snapshot.py:16-39). Git is needed only for closeout.
Implementer-level default, no owner decision: fail on a missing/differing golden and let --update-golden rewrite all goldens.

The snapshot writer is deskops/graph/snapshot.py; renaming any emitted key breaks the kg.json golden, e.g. metadata.schema (snapshot.py:19,91) or an identity/edges/semantics/source key from _kgdb_node (snapshot.py:120-140).

`files` lists touched paths, not file-type guarantees; the repo's own generator lists directories the same way (runs/planning/rewrite-plan/gen.py:472). Contents beyond the named goldens are implementer-level.

All 9 depends_on tasks are `status: deferred` under desk/drawer/tasks/ (task-rw-f0-close-only-own-primitives.md:3, task-doctor-crashes-on-deskless-roots.md:3); none is closed, so this task is genuinely blocked.
Help output contains no version string: build_parser sets only prog/description/epilog (parser.py:25-31) and no --version flag exists, so the text is static and needs no stability threshold.
